name: Korean AI Text Classifier (KLUE-RoBERTa / KoELECTRA)
limitations: Fine-tuned/evaluated for Korean text structures and agglutinative tokenization.
The model is fetched from Hugging Face on first use into the HF cache; set 'hub_model' to a local snapshot directory to run fully offline.
Prioritization signal for Korean document screening, not a definitive legal authorship claim.
notes: Explicitly declares 'trained_languages': ['ko'] so that language-gating keeps it active on Korean-dominant text (hangul_ratio > 0.3) where English-only detectors are filtered.
Only .txt/.md scan items run this profile; image/audio profiles are unaffected (modality filtering).
